description: This file defines the ForbiddenException class within the OrangeHRM Authentication Exception namespace. The class extends PHP's base Exception and implements Symfony's HttpExceptionInterface, representing an HTTP 403 Forbidden error with additional headers management.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: Exception class representing an HTTP 403 Forbidden error, capable of carrying headers and configurable status code.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception (default 403).

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for this exception.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with this exception.
